subject: Operational playbook: TAM coverage, on-call rotations & escalation matrix for Acme Financial
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmebank.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@acmebank.com
Date: 2027-12-04 09:12 -0800
Subject: Request: detailed TAM/on-call coverage and escalation flow

Hi Laura,

Thanks for the run-through in the RFP workshop yesterday. Procurement asked me to get a consolidated operational playbook that spells out the following before we move to contracting:
- TAM coverage window (hours and names) and overlap with our business hours
- On-call rotation cadence and escalation contact priorities (phone + email)
- SLA targets tied to incident severities and expected initial response times
- Communication templates for incident notifications to our ops and exec teams

Can you provide a one-pager or attachments we can share with legal/procurement? If possible, include any regional holidays or blackout periods that would affect coverage.

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a 30-min call if that's easier.

Best,
Jordan
Head of Platform Reliability
Acme Financial

--
Attachment: none
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmebank.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-12-04 11:27 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: detailed TAM/on-call coverage and escalation flow

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear list. I attached a preliminary operational playbook and the current TAM roster for Acme (Acme-TAM-Roster.xlsx). Highlights below; details are in the attached docs:

- Coverage window: Primary TAM coverage is 08:00–20:00 PT Monday–Friday (covers 11:00–23:00 ET). Weeknight on-call (20:00–08:00 PT) is handled by the on-call pool with guaranteed initial response within 60 minutes for Sev 1 incidents.

- On-call cadence: weekly rotation for the primary on-call engineer (CSV rotation attached). There is a two-person overlap on Mon/Tue mornings for handoffs. Primary roster shows names and escalation order.

- Escalation matrix:
  1) TAM (1st contact) — initial triage, runbooks, customer comms
  2) On-call SRE (if root-cause investigation needed) — pager-based escalation
  3) Regional Service Manager (marks@redwood.ai) — for cross-team coordination
  4) VP, Support (rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai) — for exec notifications and SLA exceptions

- SLAs (excerpt):
  - Sev 1: initial ack within 60 minutes, continuous updates every 60 minutes until mitigation
  - Sev 2: initial ack within 4 business hours
  - Sev 3: initial ack within 24 business hours

- Incident comms: we have templated notifications for initial alert, mitigation updates, and post-incident summaries. I included a sample incident notification in the playbook and a DocuSign link for the SLA exhibit if procurement wants it signed electronically.

Next steps: I propose a 30-min alignment call Friday 12/10 at 10:00 PT to walk the playbook and confirm names for the roster. Tell me if that works or propose an alternative.

Cheers,
Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0199

Attachments: Acme-TAM-Roster.xlsx, redwood-escalation-matrix-v3.pdf
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmebank.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-12-05 08:03 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: detailed TAM/on-call coverage and escalation flow

Jordan — quick note from the support leadership side:

- SLA exceptions: If Acme requires a formal reduction in initial response windows (e.g., 30 min for Sev 1) we can offer that in a Dedicated contract amendment; it impacts staffing and cost, which we can itemize.

- Regional holidays: we maintain published blackout calendars per region. For US east-coated banking holidays we route to the on-call pool with a higher staffing multiplier. I put a short table in the escalation PDF, and the Drive folder (linked below) includes the calendar we use to model coverage.

- Exec escalation: My expectation is that VP-level involvement only occurs for Sev 1 incidents with customer-facing outage impact >60 minutes or contractual SLA breaches. For transparency, we will send an interim summary within 2 hours and a full RCA within 72 hours unless otherwise negotiated.

Markus, please help by attaching the on-call CSV that lists the rotation windows and handoff times (Markus: attached oncall-rotation-weekly.csv).

—Rishi
VP, Support & CS Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: oncall-rotation-weekly.csv
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmebank.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@acmebank.com
Date: 2027-12-06 10:50 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: detailed TAM/on-call coverage and escalation flow

Laura / Rishi —

Thanks — this is helpful. A couple quick clarifications from procurement and our SRE lead:
1) Can you confirm whether the 60-min Sev 1 initial ack applies during major holiday windows (e.g., Dec 24–26)?
2) For the on-call phone escalation, do we have both cell and secure desk numbers, or only desk? We need at least one guaranteed reachable mobile contact for Sev 1 outside business hours.
3) Will the TAM handle post-incident customer-facing status page updates or will that be our responsibility?

We can take the call on Friday 12/10 at 10:00 PT. Please send an invite.

Jordan

Subject: Re: Request: detailed TAM/on-call coverage and escalation flow

Jordan —

Answers inline:
1) Holiday response: Our Sev 1 initial ack target remains 60 minutes during holidays, but we staff from the on-call pool and may implement an escalated staffing multiplier. If Acme wants guaranteed additional standby coverage on Dec 24–26 we can add a dedicated holiday shift (cost impact outlined in the Drive doc).

2) On-call reachability: the on-call CSV includes both desk and mobile reachability where team members have consented to provide mobile numbers. For customers requiring an exclusively secure-verified mobile contact we can establish an approved secure channel and add a named responder to the escalation matrix.

3) Status page updates: Redwood can publish customer-facing status updates on Acme's status channel (we support posting to customer-managed status pages via webhook or provide the message content for your team to post). We recommend a joint ops play for high-severity incidents where we post the initial message and Acme controls the public status page to avoid double-posting.

I sent a calendar invite for Fri 2027-12-10 10:00 PT with a short agenda (walkthrough, confirm roster, procurement open items). Agenda and pre-reads are in the Drive link.

Next actions:
- Please confirm attendees for the 12/10 call.
- If procurement needs a formal SLA exhibit change we will route through Sales/Legal — I copied Rishi to coordinate.

Thanks — look forward to the call.

Laura
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0199
